c27.title: TPM/board replacement re-enrolment refusing lower-generation restore
c27.physical_prerequisite: Authorized class-K path on real TPM/board hardware producing re-enrolment records that refuse lower-generation restore
c27.founder_prerequisite: Founder-authorized class-K recovery policy/path; engineering must not self-authorize a recovery shortcut
c27.summary: Software can model generation counters and refuse a lower generation in synthetic tests, but C27 acceptance requires authorized class-K re-enrolment records from real hardware. Shipping a local counter file or mock TPM as PASS would be an unauthorized workaround and is refused.
